name: @w6w-apps/zoom
description: Schedule and manage Zoom meetings, webinars, registrants, users and cloud recordings.

w6w.longDescription:
Zoom schedules and manages meetings and webinars from a workflow — creating, updating, fetching, listing and deleting meetings, and creating and reading webinars, so a process outside Zoom can set up a session the same way a host would in the Zoom app.

Registrants are a first-class part of the surface: a meeting can have registrants added to it and its registrant list read back, which covers a registration-gated meeting directly rather than requiring a separate signup form bolted on. Cloud recordings can be listed and deleted, and users can be looked up individually or listed in bulk to resolve who a meeting or webinar should be scheduled under.

A fit for turning an external event — a booking, a signup, a calendar trigger — into a scheduled Zoom meeting or webinar, or managing recording retention and cleanup as part of a workflow.
